name: Cultist

bonuses.name: Devotion
bonuses.text: Any time a Cultist is slain by a Critical Hit, the GM gains 1 Ruin.

abilities.name: Shoot and Stab
abilities.text: A Cultist takes no Multi-Action penalty on a turn where the elect to shoot their Autopistol and stab with their Knife.

options.name: Autogun
options.text: Cultists can replace their Autopistol and Knife with an Autogun, and the Shoot and Stab ability is replaced by For The Dark Gods!

abilities.name: For The Dark Gods!
abilities.text: Whenever a Cultist rolls a 6 on the Wrath Die, the GM gains 2 Ruin instead of 1.

options.name: Mob heavy weapons
options.text: For every ten Cultists in the Mob one may have one of the following options: Flamer or Heavy Stubber.

note: Reprint of cultist; differs in Fel 2 (Core 3), Resilience 5 (1 AR) (Core 4, 0 AR), Tier 5, Mob options. Print: 'where the elect to shoot' (sic).
